tests.title: One house · closer vs farther vs both
tests.description: Both passes give the best overall result in this short house screen. Closer-only does not cure ghosted edges and deteriorates more toward the other path; farther-only is softer. None demonstrates clean, freely explorable walls.
tests.controls: Matched driving / sideways videos · live Gaussian free view for each arm · WASD / drag / review-height lock
tests.limitation: Short5K screening; common SfM uses both passes. No off-path ground truth or surveyed road alignment. One house, not full block.

tests.title: Ford/Duffus · local Gaussian alignment preview
tests.description: Provisional two-building placement at the signed Duffus/Ford intersection, with a mapped-road fire truck and overlap controls.
tests.controls: WASD / arrows · C cab/chase · Hybrid/Map/Splat · building visibility · R recover
tests.limitation: LOCAL PREVIEW ONLY. Two fit controls and no independent checks. The current placement misses Brown/Ford by27–32m. Existing reconstruction quality is unchanged.

tests.title: New Romaine · fire truck + Gaussian lab
tests.description: Drive the Map Game pumper on terrain-following roads, with building collision, chase/driver-eye/free cameras and an optional Gaussian scenery layer.
tests.controls: WASD / arrows · brake/reverse · Space park · C camera · F free view · R recover · touch controls
tests.limitation: Playable foundation. Gaussian map alignment remains unverified (7.45 m route-fit RMS; no landmark ties); scenery quality is unchanged. Heights/road widths and vehicle handling are approximate.

tests.title: New Romaine · geographic block sandbox
tests.description: Explore the Ford–Brown–High–St. Mary’s area from the footage neighborhood: 284 source building footprints, terrain, internal streets and a simulated 1.06 km tour.
tests.controls: WASD / arrows · drag to look · walk / free flight · Q/E height · street jump · perimeter tour · touch controls
tests.limitation: Conventional mesh scaffold. All heights, facade details and road widths are estimated; no photogrammetric or surveyed-accuracy claim. Not yet aligned to the video camera solve.

tests.title: Sherbrooke · reference-built block
tests.description: Explore both sides of the Aylmer–George block. Map-shaped buildings, station bays, porches and storefronts are modeled from the original footage.
tests.controls: WASD / arrows · drag to look · auto drive · baseline comparison · source photos
tests.limitation: Stable 3D surfaces; estimated heights and hidden details. A recognizable approximation, not a photorealistic or surveyed reconstruction.

tests.title: Photo-wall drive
tests.description: Drive and move across a simple road, with real Peterborough footage turned into photo walls.
tests.controls: WASD / arrows to move · drag to look · touch controls on phones
tests.limitation: Flat facades and visible joins. Street dimensions are illustrative, not surveyed.

tests.title: 360° video drive
tests.description: Look around from the cab, change playback speed and switch to a real recorded return journey.
tests.controls: Drag to look · play and speed controls · turn around
tests.limitation: Fixed camera path. Turning around cuts to an approximately matched location on the return pass.
